_label: SECTION 1 BATCH 2A — universal Ascendant-sign application claims; development only; practitioner review required
scope: How the Ascendant sign may shape the person's general way of approaching life. Claims are conservative editorial applications of classical sign structure, not direct classical psychological delineations.
writerRule: Use the Ascendant sign as an approach or orientation, never as a complete personality. Do not include sign mythology, imagery, anatomy, appearance, caste, gender, medical temperament, status or deterministic outcomes.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Aries rising, you may approach life most naturally by moving toward what requires a beginning, meeting experience directly rather than waiting for every condition to become settled.
Taking an initial concrete action may help you discover what a situation actually requires and where your effort can be used effectively.
The urge to begin may become counterproductive when action starts before enough information, timing or direction is available.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic bravery, aggression, leadership or competitiveness
injury, conflict, military or athletic prediction

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Taurus rising, you may approach life by establishing something dependable and tangible before investing yourself more fully.
You may work best when progress can be made steadily and when time is available to strengthen what has already shown practical value.
Stability may become limiting when familiarity alone is treated as sufficient reason to preserve a direction that no longer works.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic stubbornness, materialism, sensuality or artistic taste
claim that change is inherently harmful

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Gemini rising, you may approach life by examining more than one angle and noticing how a change in language or perspective alters what becomes possible.
Conversation, questions and comparison may help you adapt your approach without requiring one first interpretation to remain final.
Adaptability may lose direction when every new possibility receives attention but none is carried far enough to become useful.

prohibitedExtensions: guaranteed intelligence, wit, communication talent or sociability
commerce, writing or media career prediction

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Cancer rising, you may approach life by first registering the human and situational context, including what appears to need protection, support or a sense of belonging.
You may act most coherently when your response fits the actual needs of the situation rather than following an impersonal method automatically.
Responsiveness may become over-adjustment when the surrounding emotional climate determines your direction more strongly than your own considered position.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic sensitivity, nurturance, domesticity or psychic intuition

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Leo rising, you may approach life by identifying the position or expression that feels genuinely yours and giving it sustained form.
You may become more effective when your outward choices remain connected to a stable internal center rather than changing solely to secure a response.
Self-expression may become rigid when recognition is treated as proof that the expression is valid, or its absence as proof that it is not.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic leadership, confidence, authority, fame or theatricality

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Virgo rising, you may approach life by observing what is actually present, distinguishing its parts and identifying what can be made more workable.
Careful adjustment may help you turn a broad intention into a practical method that can be tested and improved.
Refinement may become self-defeating when constant correction prevents you from recognizing that something is already sufficiently functional.

prohibitedExtensions: perfectionism, anxiety, obsessive or medical diagnosis
automatic service, purity, modesty or criticism
claim that every detail requires correction

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Libra rising, you may approach life by comparing positions, recognizing the other side of an exchange and looking for terms that allow movement between them.
Your approach may become clearer through dialogue and negotiation, especially when fairness is translated into explicit choices rather than left as an ideal.
Comparison may weaken direction when another person's position is consulted so repeatedly that your own judgment never becomes decisive.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic charm, beauty, diplomacy, indecision or people-pleasing
moral judgment from classical sign wording
claim that agreement is always preferable to conflict

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Scorpio rising, you may approach life by concentrating privately on what appears consequential rather than distributing your attention across every available concern.
Once you judge something to be significant, you may remain involved long enough to understand what is not immediately visible or easily resolved.
Concentration may become control when uncertainty is treated as something that must be eliminated before movement or trust is possible.

prohibitedExtensions: danger, secrecy, manipulation, sexuality, vengeance or destructive power
moral judgment from classical source language

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Sagittarius rising, you may approach life by looking for the larger direction or principle that makes a particular experience meaningful.
Exploration and learning may help you revise your direction when the current frame has become too narrow to explain what you are encountering.
A broader horizon may become an escape from application when the next possibility is pursued before the present understanding has been put into practice.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic optimism, honesty, wisdom, faith, travel or teaching ability
claim that expansion is always beneficial

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Capricorn rising, you may approach life by identifying what must be organized, made workable or carried into tangible form.
Direction may become clearer when a large responsibility is converted into defined steps, realistic limits and a structure that can be maintained.
Structure may become constricting when obligation is treated as the only legitimate basis for choosing a direction.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic discipline, ambition, pessimism, hardship or delay

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Aquarius rising, you may approach life by noticing the larger pattern or system in which an individual problem is operating.
You may sustain an alternative approach when it rests on a clear principle and improves how the larger arrangement functions.
System-level thinking may lose contact with lived reality when the principle becomes more important than the people or circumstances it is meant to serve.

prohibitedExtensions: automatic humanitarianism, rebellion, innovation, detachment or eccentricity
claim that unconventional choices are inherently superior

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: With Pisces rising, you may approach life by remaining receptive to more than one current in a situation before deciding how they fit together.
Your approach may become clearer when different impressions are gathered into one workable direction rather than being forced prematurely into a single explanation.
Receptivity may become diffusion when too many surrounding influences are allowed to shape the direction without a clear point of decision.

compositionRequirements: The writer must not present sensitivity, intuition, imagination, compassion or spirituality as direct source-supported Pisces traits unless separate admitted claims license them.
prohibitedExtensions: automatic intuition, spirituality, imagination, compassion, psychic receptivity or weak boundaries
claim that every impression is meaningful or reliable
